take_homes: What you tell the AI first changes every answer after it. Say who you are and what the job is.
Real, specific details (my actual hates, not 'bureaucracy') make the output sound like me.
I can save the rules in a file so the AI reads them every time. Maybe that works for a depot report.

monday.move: Try the rules-file idea on one delivery report: paste last week's report, write 5 lines about what the depot managers need, ask for a cleaner table. Check the depot names myself.
monday.when: Maybe Wednesday, if the report export works

misconception.why: I saw it taking my own words and rules and making output for my own work, not a customer chatbot. But every example was a personal site, so I still don't see operations yet.

one_line: The first half is fine and the hate-list part was good, but a personal website is not my job, and there was too much English reading and homework.
